project.title: Metagenome of treated tannery effluent
project.description: Samples from treated tannery effluent were collected and pooled to obtain a total volume of 200 mL. The sample was taken by MADES technicians and transported to the CEMIT laboratories under refrigeration at 4 deg C. Subsequently, it was filtered through a 0.22 um nitrocellulose membrane for subsequent DNA extraction.
project.center_name: FACEN-UNA (Facultad de Ciencias Exactas y Naturales, Universidad Nacional de Asuncion)
